stations.title: Old copies
stations.note: One never got the drop-off date.

captions: Generics are in. Next, Petra's bike, SW-1042, moves to the 22nd on the edit form.
The form uses an old copy of a booking with no drop-off date, so the date is lost.
You build every copy from Booking itself, in three tasks.
Now the change keeps every member, and the date moves.
One Booking, every type built from it. A new member reaches them all.
